name: Saltmere
opening: A ship drifted into Saltmere Harbour last night with no one aboard. The captain's dinner is still warm on the table, and something is knocking from inside the hold.
picture: a misty harbour at dusk, an empty ship with torn sails tied up at the lantern-lit docks
beats: Get aboard the empty ship without being seen
Find out what is knocking in the hold
Learn what happened to the crew
style: sea mist, lantern light, deep blues
secret: The crew were turned into seagulls by a sea witch they tried to cheat.
